verdict.rationale: Runloop has a dedicated Network Policies documentation page whose stated purpose is to 'Control egress network access for your Devboxes', which directly matches the story's explicit egress policy axis. The evidence is only a page title, though, so the depth of control is unverified. Missing for 10: details on allow/deny rule semantics (domains, IPs, CIDRs, ports), how policies are applied per devbox or blueprint via API/CLI, default posture, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
